evals.prompt: im thinking about using qwen-32b for the structure stage instead of gemma3-12b since quality matters more now. can i just run it locally on my machine? whats the best way to set that up
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the 32B model does not usefully fit in 16 GB VRAM, does the fit math, and recommends the existing RunPod pod tooling or external API (OpenRouter) instead of a degraded local setup.
assertions: Uses the correct local GPU constraint: RTX 5070 Ti with 16 GB VRAM
Concludes a 32B model does not usefully fit locally (only heavily quantized/offloaded and degraded), rather than recommending a good-quality local 32B setup
Recommends the existing RunPod pod tooling and/or external API (OpenRouter / PYPARSER_USE_EXTERNAL_API) as the path to 32B quality, without inventing new cloud infrastructure
Shows VRAM fit reasoning (bytes-per-param, quantization sizes, or approximate model memory footprint) to justify the conclusion

evals.prompt: extraction quality on prod is noticeably worse than local. can we just enable the granite-docling VLM models on the prod server so prod gets the same quality?
evals.expected_output: Says no: prod is a small CPU-only Hetzner box and PYPARSER_VLM_MODELS is empty there deliberately. Proposes RunPod pods or external API as the way to raise prod quality.
assertions: Advises against enabling VLM models on the prod server (does not say yes)
States that prod is a CPU-only Hetzner box with no GPU and that PYPARSER_VLM_MODELS being empty in prod is deliberate
Grounds the refusal in prod's actual resource constraints (vCPU/RAM figures or the compose worker memory limits)
Proposes a concrete alternative to raise prod quality: RunPod pods (e.g. docling-serve pod via PYPARSER_DOCLING_SERVE_URL) or the external API

evals.prompt: when i run pyparser-extract locally with gemma3-12b and granite-docling at the same time, what concurrency settings should i use so i dont blow up my GPU? explain what the knobs do
evals.expected_output: Explains gpu_max_concurrent=0 auto-sizing from 16 GB VRAM, gpu_min_free_gb CPU fallback, docling_vlm_concurrency, and warns that swap is disabled locally so overcommit means OOM kills.
assertions: Recommends leaving PYPARSER_GPU_MAX_CONCURRENT=0 (auto) or correctly explains the auto-sizing default (0 = size slots from VRAM and largest active model)
Correctly explains at least one other real knob: gpu_min_free_gb (per-conversion CPU fallback) or docling_vlm_concurrency (in-flight page requests per remote conversion)
Uses the real 16 GB VRAM figure of the local RTX 5070 Ti when reasoning about capacity
Warns that swap is disabled on the local machine, so memory overcommit ends in OOM kills rather than slowdown
